Publication statement: St. Paul, Minn. : St. Paul Lithog. & Eng. Co., 1872.

Relief shown by hachures. Shows roads, railroads, trails, towns, villages, settlements, and boundary lines across the Dakota Territory. "Draughted by Fred Sturnegk."
